summary: Iteration 133: Blueprint Insights Dashboard Tile testing complete. All 21 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified working - BlueprintInsightsTile displays on dashboard with rising patterns, NEW badges, Draft buttons, and deep-link navigation to /blueprints with Pattern Discovery tab auto-selected.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 133 added Blueprint Insights Dashboard Tile: (1) GET /api/blueprint-patterns/trends returns top 3 rising patterns with is_new flag for NEW patterns (prev_count=0) vs SURGING (prev_count>0, delta>0). (2) BlueprintInsightsTile component on Dashboard shows rising patterns with NEW (rose) or +N vs last wk (amber) badges. (3) Draft button deep-links to /blueprints?pattern={key}&t=tok1,tok2 which auto-selects Pattern Discovery tab. (4) Auto-open suggest dialog only triggers if matching pattern exists in the loaded patterns list (min_tickets=3 default). Note: Trends endpoint uses min_tickets=2 threshold while Pattern Discovery uses min_tickets=3, so some patterns may appear on dashboard tile but not in Pattern Discovery panel - this is intentional to catch emerging patterns early on dashboard.

trends_endpoint.details: GET /api/blueprint-patterns/trends returns correct structure with rising array, window_days, this_total, prev_total. Each pattern has key, tokens, name_guess, ticket_count_this/prev, delta, is_new, score, sample_titles, sample_ticket_ids, affected_client_ids.

trends_days_param.details: Days parameter respected and clamped to 1-60 range.

dashboard_tile.details: BlueprintInsightsTile renders on dashboard below StandupDigestBanner. Shows loading state, then rising patterns with NEW badges, ticket count, client count, sample title, and Draft button.

tile_data_testids.details: data-testid='blueprint-insights-tile' present. insight-{key} and insight-gen-{key} testids found for each pattern.

deep_link_navigation.details: Draft button navigates to /blueprints?pattern={key}&t=tok1,tok2. Pattern Discovery tab auto-selected (data-state='active').

library_tab_regression.details: Library tab still shows table of blueprints correctly.

new_blueprint_button_regression.details: New Blueprint button opens dialog correctly.

patterns_endpoint_regression.details: GET /api/blueprint-patterns still works with limit and min_tickets params.

notes: The suggest dialog auto-open only triggers when the matching pattern exists in the Pattern Discovery panel's loaded patterns. Since Pattern Discovery uses min_tickets=3 by default and test data has patterns with only 2 tickets, the auto-open doesn't trigger. This is intentional behavior as documented: 'If no patterns exist for a given URL, the auto-open simply does nothing — that's intentional, not a bug.'
